question: What minimum handoff contract prevents water-mass double-counting across Weather, Landscape and Farmland?
answer: Use one-writer immutable directed volume fluxes with explicit interval, units, source/destination, process stage and provenance. Give every source-measure conversion a unique event + interval + spatial-support key, with stage recorded separately. Keep forcing, storage, losses/discharge and presentation separate.
nextGate: Mother-owned isolated replay over a frozen support map and interval calendar, including an overlapping-support conversion negative control and separate physical/visual acceptance gates.
